thread:
alex (devex): quick async check — finalizing release checklist for the SDK/docs/quickstarts. goal: cut changelog + sampleapp freeze by Fri EOD PT. who owns each bullet?

maria (docs): I can own docs freeze and changelog aggregation. planning to merge final edits by Thu 5pm PT. pls ping PRs that still need review.

tyler (sdk): SDK packaging + pip publish on me. open PRs: #452 (windows wheel fix), #459 (readme examples). I need a green CI by Thu 3pm PT to meet Friday publish.

jordan (platform): sampleapps that hit private endpoints: we need a short stubbed mock for the product API — I can provide a docker-compose mock by Wed. ping me the exact endpoints.

sam (pm): milestone reminder: must ship SDK+quickstarts to beta users Mon morning. changelog cutoff = Fri 23:59 PT. please call out any blocker now.

lisa (qa): I'll run a smoke matrix on the sampleapps once the mock is up. need test matrix (node/python/go) — Tyler, can you confirm sampleapp language targets?

tyler (sdk): node + python for now, go optional. I'll update sampleapps repo with language tags by tonight.

alex (devex): action list I'm tracking: 1) docs freeze owner = @maria, 2) SDK CI fixes = @tyler, 3) sampleapp mock = @jordan, 4) QA matrix = @lisa, 5) changelog publish = me (I will assemble entries). correct?

maria (docs): correct. I'll create a single PR that aggregates changelog entries from each repo — please add entry lines in this format: `- [sdk] brief: PR#<num> - 1 sentence`.

sam (pm): small ask: include a note about breaking changes if any. we should highlight in the changelog header.

jordan (platform): replied re: endpoints — tagging here: `/endpoints list` -> `/v1/auth`, `/v1/generate`, `/v1/embeddings`. I'll drop a mock docker image to `ghcr.io/redwood/mock-api:v1` by Wed 11am PT.

alex (devex): CI blockers — @ci-bot reports flaky windows tests on #452. Tyler, can you triage? if not, we may bump windows to post-launch.

tyler (sdk): yep will triage. quick note: reproduce steps in PR description. ping me if you need repro logs.

lisa (qa): scheduling: I'll start smoke runs Thu evening and full matrix Fri morning. please freeze testable commits by Thu 6pm PT.

maria (docs): docs build note — new sidebar change landed in `main` and changed quickstart links. I'll open a fix PR to keep quickstarts pointing to the new samples path.

alex (devex): small ops: changelog freeze command I'll run Fri 00:00 PT: `./scripts/changelog-collect --cutoff 2001237890` (that's the ticket ts I'm using). After that, only security/critical fixes can be added.

sam (pm): sounds good. also, can we add a short 'how to upgrade' blurb to changelog for the SDK? tyler can you draft 2-3 lines.

tyler (sdk): ack, will draft upgrade notes (pin versions, migration snippet) and add to PR #459.

maria (docs): once changelog PR is up, I'll run the doc build and sanity-check links. if anything breaks, I'll revert and call for a hotfix.

alex (devex): final ask — code review pings: please leave at least 1 reviewer for each PR and mark `release/rc` label. I'll follow up tomorrow with a short checklist.

ci-bot: CI: #452 — windows/tests failed 2/5 runs. Retry queued by @tyler.

alex (devex): thanks all. I'll post a brief shiproom note Thu morning with the current status. if new blockers surface, reply in this thread so we keep the async trail.
